summary: Iteration 71 — Phase 1 food/menu checkout tested on web + backend. Backend /api/shop/orders/quote and /api/shop/orders/checkout verified against biz_sample_funpizza + Mac & Cheese Pizza ($17.99). 7/7 pytest cases pass. The core bug fix is confirmed: POST /checkout with use_gift_card=false now returns status='pending_payment' + a real Stripe checkout_url (cs_test_/checkout.stripe.com URL), so the user always reaches card entry — no more silent gift-card cover. /quote correctly recomputes subtotal/gift/points/total, caps redeemed_points to max_redeemable_points (min(balance, subtotal_after_gift*REDEEM_RATE)), and applies 100pts=$1 = 500 pts → 500 cents discount. Web e2e (legacy variant): login → /shop/menu/biz_sample_funpizza → add item → topbar-cart badge shows count=1 → menu-checkout → /shop/checkout/menu renders rl-checkout-menu-page with order summary, checkout-giftcard-toggle ($10 available, applies $10), checkout-points slider (balance 500), live checkout-total that updates when toggling gift ($7.99 gift ON → $17.99 gift OFF) and when moving slider ($17.99 → $12.99 with 500 pts), and checkout-pay 'Pay $X by card' redirecting to Stripe when total>0. Found ONE real UX bug: the gift-card toggle disappears after user turns gift OFF because the /quote response then returns gift_available_cents=0 and the render guard hides the toggle — user cannot re-enable gift once toggled off (see rca below).

ui_bugs.issue: Gift-card toggle (checkout-giftcard-toggle) disappears once user toggles gift OFF because the render guard `quote.gift_available_cents > 0` becomes false — backend /quote returns gift_available_cents=0 when use_gift_card=false. User has no way to re-enable the gift card after turning it off; only reload restores it. Fix: either (a) the render guard should track whether a gift card exists independently of use_gift_card (e.g., a persistent `gift_card_exists` flag in the /quote response), or (b) always populate gift_available_cents in /quote regardless of use_gift_card. Reference: /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/CheckoutMenuRadioLife.jsx:93 and /app/backend/routes/marketplace_orders.py:121-122

Only the UX bug (gift toggle vanishes on OFF) needs fixing — either (a) always populate gift_available_cents in /quote regardless of use_gift_card, or (b) frontend gates toggle visibility on a separate `gift_card_exists` field. rca of the issue: Gift-toggle-disappears bug: (1) Reproduction — on rl-checkout-menu-page, click checkout-giftcard-toggle to turn it OFF. The toggle disappears from the DOM. (2) Root cause — In /app/backend/routes/marketplace_orders.py:121, `gift_card = await _pick_gift_card(db, user, business_id) if use_gift_card else None` short-circuits card lookup when the toggle is off; then line 122 sets `gift_available_cents = 0`. In /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/CheckoutMenuRadioLife.jsx:93 the render guard `{quote && quote.gift_available_cents > 0 && (…)}` therefore hides the toggle entirely. (3) Mitigation — Preferred: unconditionally call _pick_gift_card in _price_menu and expose gift_available_cents (informational) plus gift_applied_cents (0 when use_gift_card=false). Alt: return a `gift_card_available: bool` flag independent of the selection state and change the frontend guard to that flag.
